label: Ikony · Thriller
desc: Ztuhlý postoj, trhnutí hlavou, drápy, krok stranou s tlesknutím, prohnutí, kroky vpřed s vlnou rukou.
desc_en: A stiff stance, the head snapping around, claws, a step to the side with a clap, an arched back, heavy steps with an arm wave.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: the dancer stands stiffly like a sleepwalker, then the head snaps around toward the camera in one jerk, and holds the stare
both hands come up in front of the chest curled like claws, shoulders lurching from side to side, and end with the claws raised
the dancer steps to one side with the feet turned out and claps the hands together once, then steps back, and ends with feet apart
the clawed hands rise above the head as the back arches and the head tilts back, and the pose holds
the dancer takes slow heavy steps toward the camera while the arms wave in a stiff wave from side to side, and stops close with the claws out
the dancer drops into a low crouch with the claws forward and the head cocked, and freezes
